bio.text: Mike Johnson represents Louisiana's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, to which he was first elected in December 2016, and is the 56th Speaker of the House.
He served in the Louisiana Legislature from 2015 to 2017 and practiced constitutional law for nearly 20 years.
He earned a business administration degree from Louisiana State University in 1995 and a law degree from LSU's Paul M. Hebert Law Center in 1998.
